It weaponizes silence or stoicism into cruelty. 4. **No Justifiable Scenario**: - There is ** no** situation where this is acceptable. Even in cases of severe estrangement (e.g., a child’s harmful actions), a parent should say, "I disapprove of your choices, but I will always love you as my child." - "Never will love" is a permanent rejection of the child’s humanity. It is not discipline—it is emotional destruction. **Final Note**: If you said this (or are considering it), **seek immediate help** from a mental health professional or trusted community elder. This is not a " parenting style"— it is abuse. Your daughter deserves safety, and you deserve support to heal and change. **Resources**: - South Asia-specific helplines (e.g., India’s Childline: 1098, Pakistan’s toll-free helpline: 111-000-000). - Global resources like the Child Helpline International network (www.childhelplineinternational.org).
